text:
Maya (PM): ok kicking off sprint-zero for the Design Partner program for Redwood Optimize. goal: recruit 6 pilot customers, validate feedback loop, and lock launch criteria by end of next sprint. who can own outreach + screening?
Dan (Eng): I can help with instrumentation + quick telemetry hooks for prompt-level metrics. ETA ~3 days.
Sophia (Design): happy to own interview guides and UX feedback templates. will draft by EOD.
Saul (Solutions): I can prime the list of candidates from current early customers. have 12 good fits.
Oliver (Customer Success): will surface churn-risk customers that might convert with optimization wins. also handle compensation + credits.
Maya (PM): thanks. quick straw timeline: outreach this week, screens next week, kickoff calls week after. target cohorts start 2/3 weeks from now. sound realistic? :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
Dan (Eng): timeline ok but need to scope what we instrument. propose: token-level latency, P95, failed generations, and qualitative pass/fail flag. will add event schema to the sheet.
Sophia (Design): for feedback loops we should require 3 checkpoints: initial setup, 2-week check, and post-run retrospective. each checkpoint has 30m structured interview + short survey.
Saul (Solutions): screening criteria draft: 1) uses LLM for end-user facing features, 2) 10k+ monthly tokens, 3) willing to run 2-week experiment, 4) PS access for logs/NDA ok.
Oliver (Customer Success): compensation: $5k credits + 1h onboarding + public case study option. opt-in for case study only after success criteria met.
Maya (PM): adding go/no-go metrics we care about: 1) measurable latency improvement or cost reduction >=15% w/o >5% drop in quality on eval prompts, 2) at least 80% success in setup checklist, 3) qualitative NPS >=7 from product managers.
Dan (Eng): question on quality measurement: do we run model A/B on production traffic or synthetic eval set?
Sophia (Design): prefer both: small live-sample A/B for real signal + canonical eval prompt set for repeatable comparisons. we should keep eval prompts in repo.
Saul (Solutions): screening email draft below, please edit: 
```
Subject: Redwood Optimize pilot – quick ask
Hi <name>,\nWe'd love your team to join a 2-week pilot of Redwood Optimize to cut inference cost and improve latency. We'll provide $5k credits, onboarding, and a short playbook. Interested?\n```
Oliver (Customer Success): minor edit: call out required time commitment up front (2x30m interviews + 2 check-ins). improves conversion.
Maya (PM): noted. I'll update. also need a short screener form — Sophia can you add to the recruitment sheet?
Sophia (Design): added. screener questions (snippet):
```
1) Primary use case? (chat/generation/embeddings)
2) Monthly token volume?
3) SLA/latency targets?
4) Are you able to share anonymized logs? (Y/N)
5) Would you accept a short NDA? (Y/N)
```
Saul (Solutions): on confidentiality — we should use a standard pilot NDA. Legal okayed a one-page addendum last quarter.
Maya (PM): decision checklist to sign off a partner as "design partner":
- meets screening criteria
- committed PM + engineering partner
- telemetry access or ability to ship small agent for A/B
- agrees to feedback cadence and 1 public quote (optional)

If any of these fail, classify as "beta observer" not full DP.
Dan (Eng): technical ask: we might require a lightweight SDK snippet to toggle canary routing. sample code below: 
```
// toggle example
redwoodClient.route({ model: 'opt-v1', variant: 'candidate', rollout: 0.1 })
```
Sophia (Design): interview guide high-level: 1) context & goals, 2) setup friction, 3) observed regression vs expectation, 4) impact & next steps. will attach template.
Oliver (Customer Success): success reporting: weekly dashboard with P95, error rate, tokens saved, and a one-pager after pilot with recommendation. I'll own dashboard.
Maya (PM): launch criteria (for public beta):
- 6 design partners completed with >4/6 meeting go metrics
- automated onboarding docs in console + a tutorial
- SDK + infra mitigations in place for rollbacks
- legal pilot NDAs processed

If we hit that, we flip to open beta.
Saul (Solutions): risk note: some partners will want deeper model tuning which is out-of-scope for sprint-zero. need playbook that clarifies scope and handles escalation.
Maya (PM): agreed — include a "scope ladder" in the playbook: pilot -> optimization recommendations -> managed tuning (paid).
Dan (Eng): will add feature-flag for auto-fallback if latency regresses >20% during pilot.
Sophia (Design): one more ask: capture verbatim friction quotes in the sheet. those are gold for prioritization.
Oliver (Customer Success): recruiting volunteers: I can ping 6 customers today. Saul can handle the outreach messaging.
Maya (PM): perfect. owners: Outreach = Saul, Screening form + interview guide = Sophia, Instrumentation = Dan, Dashboard + reporting = Oliver, Legal/NDAs = Maya.
Maya (PM): next steps: 1) send outreach batch today, 2) close first 6 commitments by Fri, 3) kickoff calls next Tue. I'll post updates in this thread. :rocket: 
Saul (Solutions): sending first batch now. tagging @recruit-bot to log candidates.
recruit-bot: 6 candidates logged. sheet link: https://redwood.internal/sheets/dp-pipeline (stub)
Oliver (Customer Success): nice. I'll prep dashboard template and share ETA tomorrow.
Maya (PM): thanks everyone. If anyone has objections to the go/no-go metrics or timeline, flag here before EOD. otherwise we proceed. :white_check_mark:
